## Verification / 验证

## Risks / 风险

Does this affect stored data, account/agent ownership, permissions, task cancellation, or upgrade paths?
是否影响已有数据、账号/Agent 归属、权限、任务中止或升级路径？

## Checklist / 检查清单

- [ ] Added a regression test or explained why it is unnecessary. / 已加回归测试或说明无需添加的原因。
- [ ] Checked Chinese and English labels for UI changes. / 界面变更已检查中英文标签。
- [ ] Removed personal paths, credentials and private fixture data. / 已移除个人路径、凭证及私人测试数据。
- [ ] Documented migrations, dependency changes and known limitations. / 已说明迁移、依赖变化及已知限制。
- [ ] Did not add login startup items or silently change existing device pairing. / 未新增开机启动或静默更改已有设备配对。
